protocol.hyperparameters: Frozen prior family choices; no per-fold or held-out architecture tuning
protocol.neural: All selected representations plus 24h summaries, actual event type and dated reward metadata; train-only input support masks
protocol.lstm: Raw LSTM 32/16, same raw inputs and small summaries plus reward metadata; batched query branches, train-only input masks
protocol.role_transfer: T1500 may borrow recent legacy T1000 completion/pace priors only; no surrogate T1500 supervised labels
protocol.stress: Fixed 6h/24h tracker gaps at an early, middle and late 08:00 checkpoint per validation event
protocol.selection: Three equal chronological fold scores (MAPE + absolute bias by tier/horizon) plus 0.25*fold-score std; paired baseline bias and final-day guards
protocol.test_policy: Historical replay on previously inspected events, not fresh validation; 325/326 remain excluded from every fit and selection
protocol.authorization: Reuse earlier protected events under the explicit all-except-325/326 refit instruction; keep the ledger unchanged

all_timestamp_lstm.scope: All hourly and original focal-tier tracker timestamps; T500/T1000/T1500/T2000
limitations: Only twelve historical event clusters; dense observations are not independent samples
Actual-time density varies by event and tier; primary matched-clock comparison is reported separately
An untrained T1500 head uses its linear anchor before joint rank reconciliation, explicitly counted as unsupported
Previously inspected historical replay, not fresh generalization
Twelve historical post-rule events; already inspected, not a fresh test
Cold-start has no post-rule training example; upweighting cannot manufacture one
Bootstrap/per-type evidence is limited by event count and serial dependence
